description: Generate a cross-tabulation pivot table across two demographic dimensions. Returns rows, columns, bounded cells, total_count for the full population, displayed_count for visible cells, and truncated when row/column limits omit categories. Accepts EXACTLY ONE of: filters (flat array), filter_groups, segment_id, audience_id, or segment_ids+set_logic to define the audience population (more than one is rejected with AMBIGUOUS_INPUT). Grouped logic, saved audience exclusions, and record limits are preserved. Requires 'discovery' scope.
